title: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance Foundation
purpose: Prepare a reviewed import path for Greek and Hebrew Strong's lookup data without publishing unclear digital datasets.
rights_policy: The original Strong's Exhaustive Concordance is public domain in the United States, but each modern digital transcription, mapping file, lexicon enhancement, or morphology dataset must be separately reviewed before public import.

approved_sample_source.title: Manual verified Strong's sample entries
approved_sample_source.author: Father's Business Bible Study review
approved_sample_source.rights_status: Reviewed sample metadata. Do not treat as a full lexical dataset.
approved_sample_source.commercial_use_notes: Safe for prototype testing because entries are short manually reviewed summaries. Replace or expand only from documented rights-safe sources.
approved_sample_source.attribution_notes: Derived for internal prototype lookup from public-domain Strong's numbering tradition with KJV-centered plain-English summaries.

approved_public_domain_sources.title: Strong's Greek Bible Dictionary
approved_public_domain_sources.author: James Strong
approved_public_domain_sources.commercial_use_notes: CrossWire lists the module distribution license as Public Domain. Use for reviewed concise lexicon entries and preserve source attribution.

approved_public_domain_sources.title: Strong's Hebrew Bible Dictionary
approved_public_domain_sources.author: James Strong
approved_public_domain_sources.commercial_use_notes: CrossWire lists the module as Public Domain / Copy Freely and the distribution license as Public Domain. Use for reviewed concise lexicon entries and preserve source attribution.

approved_public_domain_sources.title: Strong's Greek Dictionary in XML with real Greek
approved_public_domain_sources.author: James Strong; XML edition by Ulrik Sandborg-Petersen
approved_public_domain_sources.commercial_use_notes: The project README says the XML work is released under the Creative Commons CC0 waiver and derives from Strong's 1890 public-domain dictionary. Use for reviewed Greek lexicon lookup entries and preserve source attribution.

approved_general_public_license_sources.title: CrossWire KJV 1769 with Strong's Numbers and Morphology
approved_general_public_license_sources.rights_status: CrossWire general public license for any purpose
approved_general_public_license_sources.commercial_use_notes: CrossWire states that any copyright in its maintained KJV effort is held by CrossWire Bible Society and grants a general public license to use the text for any purpose. Preserve CrossWire attribution and source links.
approved_general_public_license_sources.attribution_notes: The Old Testament Strong's numbers derive from The Bible Foundation; the OSIS XML markup is maintained by CrossWire Bible Society.

candidate_sources_needing_review.title: Original Strong's Exhaustive Concordance scan
candidate_sources_needing_review.author: James Strong
candidate_sources_needing_review.notes: Use to verify original public-domain definitions and numbering. OCR quality must be reviewed before import.

candidate_sources_needing_review.title: Open digital Strong's datasets
candidate_sources_needing_review.notes: License terms, attribution requirements, data quality, and derivative work status must be documented before import.
